diagnostic_evidence.quote: Therefore, $(\fv^{(1)},\ldots,\fv^{(\ell)},\fw)$ is a pSVT with singular value one, since $(\fv^{(1)},\ldots,\fv^{(\ell)})$ is a pSVT of $\sR_s$ and $\fw = \sT\cdot \bigotimes_{i=1}^\ell (\fv^{(i)})^{\otimes d_i}.$

issues.failure_explanation: A singular-value-one pSVT gives only one of the two equations needed for a singular pair of the flattening (the equation involving M^T u = w), not the other equation M u = w; the proof nevertheless applies the matrix lemma as if (u,w) were a full singular pair. In the decomposition part, the pSVT equations for T are not shown from the pSVT equations for Rs_i; cross terms in the contractions are ignored.

failure_location.quote: Then $(\Vect(\sR_s), \fw)$ is a singular vector pair of $\bM$ with singular value one.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must prove that a singular-value-one pSVT yields both equations of a singular pair of the flattening and that each decomposition summand satisfies all pSVT equations, or weaken the statement with the missing orthogonality/unique-span hypotheses.
issues.overall_effect: The central one-to-one correspondence between summands and pSVTs of singular value one, and the algorithmic recovery guarantee built on it, become unreliable.
issues.title: Main pSVT-decomposition correspondence proof is invalid
issues.why_classification: The defect attacks the core correctness theorem; without the missing argument the advertised correspondence does not survive, and no local correction in the source restores it.

issues.failure_explanation: The proof writes dim colspace(T^(f)) + dim X < N-1 and then claims this is equivalent to r <= n_codim^f. If dim colspace is the vector-space dimension r, the inequality is r + dim X < N-1, i.e. r < n_codim^f, not r <= n_codim^f. The boundary case r = n_codim^f is therefore not justified as written.

failure_location.quote: which is equivalent to $r \leq n_{\rm codim}^f$

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Use the projective dimension r-1 for the colspace, or correct the strict inequality/equivalence so that the trisecant argument actually covers r = n_codim^f.
issues.overall_effect: The stated maximal-rank formula is not supported at its boundary values, and downstream rank guarantees using r(f) are affected.
issues.title: Rank-bound proof uses an incorrect dimension/equivalence at the boundary
issues.why_classification: The repair is a local correction of a dimension/off-by-one statement; the advertised formula and scope survive if the boundary condition is written correctly.

issues.failure_explanation: The eigenvector equations are for a normalized pair (v,w) with ||v||^2+||w||^2=1, not with ||w||^2=1. Multiplying the second equation by w^H gives λ||w||^2 = λ μ̄/α_2 + β_2, not λ = λ μ̄/α_2 + β_2. The subsequent spectral estimate relies on the incorrect relation.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must restore the missing ||v||^2 and ||w||^2 factors in the Rayleigh quotient equations and re-derive the spectral-radius bound.
issues.overall_effect: The proof that the Jacobian has spectral radius < 1 is invalid as written.
issues.title: Local convergence proof drops norm factors in the eigenvalue equations
issues.why_classification: The local linear convergence proof's central spectral argument is algebraically incorrect, and the source does not supply a corrected argument.

issues.failure_explanation: The estimate replaces |x|^{ℓ f_j} by x^2 and then sums. For ℓ f_j = 1, this is false for |x|<1. Concrete counterexample: ℓ=1, r=2, m=2, f_1=1, R^1=e_1, R^2=e_2, and w=(e_1+e_2)/√2. Then F_Acal(w)=1, max_i |⟨R^i,T_w⟩|=1/√2, and C=1, so the claimed upper bound 1 ≤ 1/√2 fails.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the invalid |x|^{ℓ f_j}≤x^2 step with a valid bound, for example by introducing a Cauchy-Schwarz √r factor, or restrict to regimes where ℓ f_j≥2, and update the constant C accordingly.
issues.overall_effect: The theorem's upper bound relating F_Acal to the best individual rank-one inner product is false in the general regime stated.
issues.title: Projection-objective upper bound is false when the per-mode exponent is 1
issues.why_classification: A comparable bound can be recovered by a contained correction of the estimate, but the theorem as stated is false without it.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: The tuple \(f\) is \emph{symmetry breaking} for \(d\) if \(f\) there exists an index \(i\) with \(f_i>0\) and \(d_i-f_i>0\).

issues.failure_explanation: The corollary lists case 1 for all f_i>0 with r_max(f)=r(f) and case 2 for symmetry-breaking f with r_max(f)=min{r(f),r(d-f)}. These cases overlap when all f_i>0 but some d_i>f_i. For example, d=(2,1), f=(1,1) is all-positive and symmetry-breaking, and the two formulas can give different values, so the statement is inconsistent as written.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Make the cases mutually exclusive, for example by applying the symmetry-breaking formula only when some f_i=0 or when complement recovery through d-f is actually required, and state the precedence of the all-positive case.
issues.overall_effect: The advertised maximal recovery rank formula is ambiguous and can be wrong for overlapping flattening types.
issues.title: Maximal recovery rank corollary has overlapping inconsistent cases
issues.why_classification: The source already distinguishes the all-positive complement case in the surrounding discussion, so a local clarification of the case hierarchy preserves the intended result.

issues.failure_explanation: The algorithm forms U,D,V by SVD but never assigns the matrix C used in the deflation formula. The proven deflation proposition assumes a factorization T^(f)=U C^{-1} V^T, so C must be D^{-1} (up to consistent convention), not the singular-value matrix D. As written, the algorithm's deflation step is not well-defined relative to its proven invariant.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Define C consistently with the SVD factorization used in the deflation proposition (e.g. set C=D^{-1} after truncation) and correct the undefined α_u/α_v notation to fa_u/fa_v.
issues.overall_effect: The stated execution of the deflation step and the algorithm's output guarantee are unsupported by the written procedure.
issues.title: MSPM algorithm uses an undefined C matrix inconsistent with the SVD setup
issues.why_classification: The repair is a local assignment/notation fix that makes the algorithm match the already stated deflation formula without changing the mathematical guarantee.
